clip.quote: I realized I don't have to be something that I'm not. I just have to show up as myself and give people the information they're actually looking for.
clip.why_clipworthy: This moment emphasizes the power of authenticity, a key message for agents hesitant about video content.
clip.suggested_hook: Think you need to be perfect on camera? Think again.
